from app.core.foundation_runtime import (
    OperationHandoff, record_operation_handoff, record_operation_handoff_result,
    run_foundation_search,
)

foundation = run_foundation_search(self, ctx, seed_resolved_params,
                                   observation=observation, binding=binding)
if isinstance(foundation, OperationHandoff):
    record_operation_handoff(foundation)
    with legacy_budget(observation is not None):
        result = handle_normal_flow(observed_deps(deps, observation, binding), ctx)
    record_operation_handoff_result(foundation, result)
    params = result.get("resolved_params") or {}
    result["_continuation_owner"] = "ACTOR" if params.get("actor_scope") or params.get("actor_pending") else "TABULAR"
    return result
if foundation is not None:
    foundation["_continuation_owner"] = "NONE"
    return foundation
